title_en: Good News (12/20): A Robot That Restores Coral Reefs
note_en: 除了 A，还 B means "besides A, also B": A is included and B is added on top. 除了种植珊瑚，这种机器人还能监测水温和水质 "Besides planting coral, the robot can also monitor water temperature and quality." Watch the second half: with 还 or 也 it adds ("as well as"), but with 都 it excludes (除了他，大家都来了 "Everyone came except him").
